mcq.q: Internet etiquette is commonly referred to as:
Which is good netiquette in an online forum?
Before posting a comment, you should ensure it is:
mcq.e: Comments should be respectful and relevant.

mcq.q: The main privacy concern with Instant Messaging applications is:
mcq.e: Whether messages and personal data are protected from interception is data security.

mcq.q: Which statement about social media is correct?
o: Children's sharing must be monitored at all times
Social media addiction does not affect studies
Rumours and fake news cannot risk law and order
mcq.e: The other options wrongly deny real risks.

mcq.q: Which of the following is a cyber crime?
o: Posting pictures of people online without their permission
Buying a computer from a shop
Accessing your own bank account online
mcq.e: The means (electronic) decides. Stealing a monitor is plain theft.

mcq.q: Gaining illegal entry to computer files through remote terminals or microcomputers is called:
mcq.e: This is the definition of hacking.

mcq.q: Perverse software is another name for:
Which malware does not perform any destructive action directly but only consumes system resources?
mcq.e: A worm self-replicates across the network, consuming resources.

mcq.q: In cyber security, the law provides which remedy?
mcq.t: 15.3 Cyber Law, the IT Act and Data Protection

mcq.q: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, a 'Child' is an individual who has not completed the age of:
mcq.e: The Act defines child as under eighteen.
mcq.t: 15.3 Cyber Law, the IT Act and Data Protection

mcq.q: The e-commerce model selling products or services online directly from producer to consumer without an intermediary is:
mcq.t: 15.3 Cyber Law, the IT Act and Data Protection

mcq.q: Which term describes the right that enables a creator or owner to earn recognition or financial benefit from a creation or invention?
mcq.e: IPR is the umbrella term; copyright covers only creative works.
Patent protects inventions; copyright protects creative works; trademark protects brands.

mcq.q: Irreparable computers and other electronic goods are known as:
Exposure variability in e-waste handling comes mainly from the:
mcq.e: Different devices carry different hazardous materials.

tf.s: Insults, personal attacks and spam are netiquette violations.
tf.n: They are all wrong online behaviour.

tf.s: Stealing an LED monitor is a cyber crime.
tf.n: False: it is ordinary theft; the means, not the object, decides.

tf.s: A virus needs a host program, whereas a worm self-replicates without a host.
tf.n: Worm spreads over the network without a host.

tf.s: Hacking is an offence under the IT Act only if damage follows.
tf.n: False: unauthorised access is an offence whether or not damage follows.

tf.s: Under the DPDP Act 2023, digital personal data means data in physical form.
tf.n: False: it means data in digital form.

tf.s: Patents are granted for a fixed period, typically 20 years.
tf.n: After the term the work enters the public domain.
False: copyright protects creative works; patents protect inventions.

tf.s: E-Waste (Management) Rules 2016 include fluorescent and mercury-containing material.

fill.q: The privacy concern with Instant Messaging applications is data ______.
Perverse software is another name for ______ software.
A ______ consumes system resources by self-replicating over the network without a host.
Under the DPDP Act 2023 a child has not completed the age of ______ years.
IPR rights are granted to the creator or inventor for a certain ______ of time.
Irreparable computers and other electronic goods are called ______ waste.
